description.value: Hold your breath for far longer than an untrained diver could manage, and gain a bonus to Athletics checks made to swim against current, pressure, or debris in flooded ruins.

cinderfall.incomplete: The card states a bonus but gives no numeric value, bonus type, or specific action tag to build a FlatModifier from without inventing one. and the Athletics bonus is gated on 'swimming against current, pressure, or debris in flooded ruins', an environmental condition with no roll-option hook: pf2e's terrain roll options come from a closed environmentTypes enum (aquatic/arctic/desert/forest/mountain/plains/swamp/underground/urban; pf2e-source/src/module/scene/region-behavior/environment.ts:16-20, StringField choices restricted to that list) that has none of Cinderfall's wasteland terrain, and there is no GM-facing way to add to it. Real Rock Runner's own terrain:stone/terrain:earth predicate values aren't in that enum either, confirming this is a closed system, not a GM-extensible one.
